entries.reason: iOS 8.2 is a point release between the two HealthKit images this workspace holds, and the one member and one constant it added are what iOS 9.0's own image exports, so the values and the behaviour are read out of that release
entries.effect: the value HealthKit gave it - "dateComponents" - read out of the armv7 shared cache of iOS 8.2. The SDK header this library is compiled against dates this constant 9.3, and the release's own image says 8.2: the armv7 shared cache of 8.2 exports it and the one of 8.0 does not, so it is carried here and the header's later date is recorded rather than followed. It is the key path the two activity-summary predicates of HKQuery are built over, and HKActivitySummary answers it
